# Home Energy Magazine Archive

> Complete archive of Home Energy Magazine — the leading publication for the residential energy efficiency and home performance industry since 1984.

## About
This archive contains 837 articles and 1,092 blog posts published between 2001 and 2020 covering:
- Residential energy efficiency and weatherization
- HVAC systems, heat pumps, and air sealing
- Building science and home performance contracting
- Green building, insulation, and solar energy
- Energy codes, ratings (HERS), and programs (Energy Star, LEED)

## Content
- Articles: https://homeenergyarchive.org/articles/ — 837 full-length magazine articles (2001–2019)
- Blog: https://homeenergyarchive.org/blogs/ — 1,092 blog posts by industry experts (2006–2020)
- Sitemap: https://homeenergyarchive.org/sitemap.xml

## Key Authors
Jim Gunshinan, Alan Meier, Macie Melendez, Shawna Henderson, Allan Chen, Elisa Wood, Ted Shoemaker, Mike Rogers
